title: PublicHealth AirPollutionClinicPanel

stats.done_summary: Completed the analysis of the daily panel data on PM2.5 and respiratory clinic visits. Conducted EDA, fitted Poisson and Negative Binomial regression models to account for count data overdispersion, and performed a policy counterfactual simulation (20% PM2.5 reduction). Generated visualizations and compiled all findings into a comprehensive report (`report/report.md`).
